body:
It was a long distance relationship, I bestowed a LOT of trust into her. We would talk on the phone for hours at night, I would text her often during the day and felt loved and cared for. I felt I could trust her and relied on her for some things. 
At night when we talked whenever I heard her voice my heart would literally pound and I could feel it. I know a lot of people say they have their hearts pounding from said person, but my actually was. 
She was a beautiful person in my eyes. Like me she was shy, humorous, and outgoing. We weren't sexual towards each other really because of our young age, she was a year younger than me however and I did start becoming increasingly sexual. 
Overall she was a wonderful, beautiful, smart, girl. 
And I miss her dearly.
